text:
Strontium-89 is a radioactive beta-emitter used to treat bone cancers.
A solution of strontium chloride is injected into patients and accumulates in their bones.
Which statement about this treatment is not correct?
A
Beta radiation is a form of electromagnetic radiation.
B
Beta-particles are a form of ionising radiation.
C
The strontium-89 atoms change to atoms of another element when they decay.
D
Beta-particles are negatively charged.

options.label: A
options.text: Beta radiation is a form of electromagnetic radiation.

options.label: B
options.text: Beta-particles are a form of ionising radiation.

options.label: C
options.text: The strontium-89 atoms change to atoms of another element when they decay.

subject: Physics
